findings.title: Joint and several liability for all users

findings.plain_language_explanation: If you share this account with anyone, you're both responsible for ALL debt on the account, even if the other person made the charges.
findings.user_impact: You could owe money for charges you didn't make if you add another user to your account.
findings.estimated_risk_scenario: If you add an adult child to help with bills and they overspend, you're legally responsible for their entire debt even if you can't afford it on your fixed income.

recommended_actions.action: Don't add anyone to your account unless absolutely necessary and you fully trust them

findings.triggered_by: We may apply Your Minimum Payment to Balance Categories in the order We choose.

findings.plain_language_explanation: The credit card company can decide how to apply your payments across different balances. They'll likely pay off low-interest debt first, keeping high-interest debt longer.
